notes: P2: Card (10c-spec §1-6). Sizes: poster 124x186 dp (home rows, grids), compact 116x174 (AI page), wide 176x99 (episode cards), frame 224x140 (Continue Watching).
Fixture assumption (02 §3.1): row 0 = continue (two frame cards with progress + one episode card (wide) + one up-next), row 1 = recent (NEW tags), row 2+ = mixed poster rows.
The compact card only exists on the AI page, which needs an answer: the state requires the instance started with AURORA_AI_MOCK (declare --server aiMock).
blur-up and broken->tile need the instance started with --art-delay 600000 / --art-fail 1 (02 §3.3); declare --server artDelay / --server artFail, otherwise the states are skipped.
Compares in F already native? No: the A side is ALWAYS all-js; B flips only this file's letters (C). To test C on top of a native F, run with --impl FC.
